reviews.text: Excellent professional welcome, attentive, responsive and available, thank you Elodie and her colleagues

A truly pleasant and professional team! The veterinarians and veterinary nurses are all competent, attentive, and responsive to each animal's needs. You quickly feel confident and well supported, with clear explanations and a great deal of kindness. I highly recommend this team!

Dr. Debette took care of my 7-year-old pug. She received excellent care, and he's a very kind veterinarian who took the time to explain the surgical procedure and post-operative care.

The nurse sent me a photo of my dog ​​once she woke up from the anesthesia, which was very reassuring.

And a huge thank you to the two receptionists who do an incredible amount of work calmly and efficiently. A message to HR: this clinic could use an additional full-time equivalent (FTE) for reception!

Thank you to the entire Soléa team.

An excellent team and clinic. My cat, who survived a fall from the 4th floor, received almost immediate care. Dr. Isnard was very professional and kind, as was the veterinary assistant team.

A huge thank you to everyone ❤️

My mother's cat is seen by Dr. Derre, who is very kind and professional.
The reception staff are pleasant.

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Soléa Veterinary Clinic for everything you do for our Tom. 🐾❤️

Since his health issues began, we've found so much more than just care: attentive listening, great availability, kindness, and a lot of care… and above all, a genuine affection for your little patient, who isn't always the most cooperative! 😄

A special thank you to Dr. Saban and Dr. Mourou for their professionalism, thoroughness, clear explanations, and attentive follow-up with Tom.

Thank you also to all the veterinary assistants, always available and caring, with a special mention and a little wink to Chloé, for her messages about Tom. She's always serious when necessary, but with that kind touch that's so comforting when we're worried. 😊

When your pet is going through a difficult time, feeling cared for by a team that doesn't just see "a patient," but is genuinely interested in them and their progress, is incredibly reassuring.

So, from Tom (who, admittedly, might not give you 5 stars every time 😜) and especially from us: a huge thank you to the entire Soléa team for your care, patience, and compassion.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Well deserved!
My dog ​​recently had dental surgery and everything went perfectly. The reception, the care, the report and the follow-up were impeccable.

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Soléa clinic, and especially Dr. Zoé Isnard and Fanny :) Referred for a broken tooth, they were able to give me an appointment quite quickly and provided gentle, competent, and effective care!
Special mention for their adaptability to our hypersensitive dog, with no more handling than necessary, the option to accompany him, and information provided throughout the procedure!
We hope we won't have to go back ;) but we know it's a great place!!
An efficient, friendly, reassuring and caring team that helped our dog Vibouille get out of some very bad situations… Thank you to the whole team!

A huge thank you to everyone, from the reception staff to the caregivers and especially to the surgeon, Dr. Saban. We received a call after the procedure, and then the surgeon called us at the end of the day. I received photos and updates late in the afternoon, and another call the following morning. You all took such good care of our little Onyx during his gallbladder surgery. We thank you for your dedication, professionalism, and empathy.
The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and professional! They took excellent care of my dog; I highly recommend them!
All the staff are very welcoming and professional. Just add some signs in the parking lot to make it easier to find your way around.

Highly competent specialized care center.
I recommend Dr. Lecru, dermatologist; he is very attentive and provides valuable email follow-up.

I took my cat to this clinic, to the dental department, for a fairly significant tooth extraction. I was quite worried, but the care my pet received and the explanations Dr. Isnard gave me before and after the operation reassured me greatly. I also received regular updates on my cat thanks to Céline, the assistant. In short, the staff I dealt with perfectly combined professionalism and kindness. I thank them from the bottom of my heart for their work and dedication.

A very nice place. Brand new, followed by my Yorkie's check-up with the vet. The facility is spacious. Pleasant receptionist. Cardiac ultrasound check-up. Always very efficient and competent. Location with underground parking.
The vet explained the condition very well despite the complexity of the case. A very welcoming and attentive team.

The team is very attentive, patient, and reassuring.

They took care of our dog, Taiga, today and were very patient and helpful. They explained each step and were very kind to our rescue dog. I recommend them 100%.

Visit yesterday, Thursday, June 18, 2026
I arrived at 8:45 a.m. for a 9:00 a.m. appointment, and Trésor was seen immediately.
The team was very empathetic, and the surgeon explained the procedure very well and was very reassuring. I received a phone call to let me know the operation had gone well and that my dog ​​was awake. The operation was successful, the report was very clear, and the surgeon saw me again that evening to explain everything and the next steps. The care was perfect, thank you very much.

First visit: appointment for a scan at 9 am, the dog was seen 30 minutes later only to be told the scanner wasn't working. The dog spent the whole day there for nothing but a blood test and wasted time on our end, professionally speaking. So, another appointment on Thursday at 8 am, and of course, we had to make arrangements, but 45 minutes later, still no one was seen. We have to wait 🤷‍♀️ hoping they'll at least provide concrete and effective help for the dog...
